resources.string: Convert units and suggest links, maps, phone and tracking actions

Conversions run offline. Supports temperature, distance, mass, US cooking measures and time. Try 10oz to g, maps Bengaluru, a phone number, flight AI101, track followed by a package number, or paste a web link or Bitcoin/Ethereum address. Tracking and explorer results open the named website only when selected; Chikku does not fetch status or verify addresses. Phone results open a dialer or message composer for you to review.
Place widgets over other items. Turning this off keeps existing placements.
Zero keeps the provider’s own corners. Larger values round the visible widget content.

App shortcuts can expose conversations, playlists or other actions when an installed app publishes them to Android. Enable App shortcuts and make Chikku the default home app. Available actions depend on each app and profile. Chikku has no direct account connection to Spotify, Slack, Reddit, Netflix or Sesame, and does not read private content from them.
